Helpful answers

Frequently asked questions

What you need to know before and after ordering.

How do I receive my key?

After a successful purchase, select Show code to view and copy your key. Keep it safe and do not share it.

How do I know if a product is right for me?

Check the description, requirements and subscription period before purchasing. If you need help choosing, contact support before placing your order.

What if I have a problem with my key or product?

Open a support ticket with your order number, a description of the issue and a screenshot of any error. Do not post your key in public channels. Our team will help investigate.

EVU CORE

Your next experience, on your terms.

Terms and conditions

Your account and store security

We aim to provide a safe, transparent experience. We restrict access, suspend membership or close an account only for violations of store policies or conduct that harms our systems or security.

Where possible, we explain the reason and give you an opportunity to resolve the issue. Urgent security concerns may require temporary restrictions while we investigate. You may contact support to request a review. Your existing order entitlements and statutory rights remain protected.

Before ordering

Read the product description, requirements, duration and terms before purchasing. For questions, open a Discord ticket before paying. Free products and services are offered only when announced by the store.

Orders and delivery

Eligible digital products are delivered automatically after payment confirmation. Custom orders follow the agreed specifications. Changes after work begins require a new agreement. Additions requested after delivery are separate orders, except corrections for defects or non-conformity with the agreed specifications.

Technical support

Product support is available for 7 days after purchase unless the description specifies a different scope for file support. File support covers issues with the files, not installation, additional scripts or other services unless included. Additional services may have a fee agreed in advance.

We work to resolve product issues. If a solution is unavailable, an appropriate remedy is agreed under our refund policy and applicable statutory rights. A ticket may be closed after 12 hours without a response, but you can contact us again and retain all applicable rights.

Conduct and updates

We treat customers respectfully and ask for respectful conduct in support channels. Prices and terms may change for future orders without affecting agreements or rights relating to earlier orders.

Privacy policy

Information you provide through the store or support channels is used to process your order, verify payment and delivery, provide support and communicate about the service.

Order and payment data is processed through Zero and the relevant service providers under their policies. The store uses and shares data only as needed for orders, support and legal obligations.

Discord account data and messages are also subject to Discord policies. Do not send passwords, verification codes or payment card details in support tickets.

Contact our official support channel with data questions or requests to correct or delete data, subject to legal obligations and order requirements.

Refund policy

Our products are digital and delivered automatically. Once a key is activated, a product is downloaded or its benefits are used, change-of-mind refunds are not available to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Defective or non-conforming products

If your key or product is defective or differs from the description or agreed specifications, open a ticket with your order number and issue details. We investigate and provide repair, replacement or a refund as appropriate under your statutory rights. A replacement will not be imposed instead of a legally required refund without your agreement.

Compensation does not cover damage proven to result from misuse or failure to follow stated requirements, without limiting customer statutory rights or the store's responsibility for product defects.

This policy does not remove any cancellation, refund or compensation rights provided by law. Payment or closure of a support ticket does not waive those rights.

Usage rights

Purchasing grants a right to use the product under its description, license and duration; it does not transfer intellectual property ownership. Keys or files may not be resold, distributed, published or modified for resale without the rights holder's express permission.

All rights to EVU CORE’s original content are reserved. Third-party marks, images, software, and materials remain the property of their respective owners and are subject to their licenses and terms.

Customers must provide accurate order information, safeguard keys and files, and follow product requirements and relevant third-party terms. Each party's responsibilities are determined by law and agreement. These terms do not exempt the store from its legal obligations.

Terms of use

System and data security

Products must not be used for unauthorized access to accounts, devices or systems; theft or destruction of data; distribution of malware; disruption of services; or circumvention of security controls.

Third-party terms

Users must comply with the terms of the games, platforms and services they use and with the scope of their license. Purchasing does not authorize violations of those terms or use beyond permitted access rights.

If misuse is suspected, the affected service may be restricted or suspended while we investigate and contact the user, under applicable laws and terms and without limiting statutory rights.
